{"type":"deployment","sha":"7d0873efe05bda2bfe1872dc50691e35617c8af0","repoName":"barakuziel-vxt/vxt","actor":"barakuziel-vxt","slotName":"production","commitMessage":"Fix startup.sh: use dynamic Python path instead of hardcoded /usr/bin/python3

/usr/bin/python3 does not exist in appsvc/python:3.11 container.
Oryx activates antenv before calling startup.sh, so python3 is in PATH.
Using 'command -v python3.11 || python3 || python' for robust detection.

Root cause: old Docker Hub image (barakdoc/vxt-web-app:latest with pymssql 2.3.0)
was serving requests because startup.sh always failed, preventing the new
appsvc/python:3.11 container from starting successfully."}
